item.title: Measuring AI Ability to Complete Long Tasks: Opus 4.5 has 50% horizon of 4h49M
item.description:
📝 Extrapolating this trend predicts that, in under a decade, we will see AI agents that can independently complete a large fraction of software tasks that currently take humans days or weeks. We find that measuring the length of tasks that models can complete is a helpful lens for understanding current AI capabilities. That being said, by looking at historical data, we see that the length of tasks that state-of-the-art models can complete (with 50% probability) has increased dramatically over the last 6 years.
🔗 Read more: https://metr.org/blog/2025-03-19-measuring-ai-ability-to-complete-long-tasks/
